warmUp.detail: Walk comfortably, building to a brisk pace.

warmUp.name: Easy jog
warmUp.detail: Very easy straight-line jogging; walk turns.

warmUp.name: Standing ankle rocks
warmUp.detail: 8 each side; heel down, knee gently forwards.

warmUp.name: Standing calf raise
warmUp.detail: 10 controlled bodyweight repetitions.

warmUp.name: Marching knee lifts
warmUp.detail: 10 each side, tall posture.

warmUp.name: Supported leg swings
warmUp.detail: 8 forwards/backwards each side; small comfortable range.

warmUp.name: Easy build-up runs
warmUp.detail: 2 x 15 m at approximately 50-60% effort; slow over 10 m, walk back. Use remaining time to rest.

main.name: Easy field run / walk
main.detail: 6 rounds: 60 seconds easy jog, 60 seconds walk. RPE 3-4/10, at most 5. Use long straight lines; slow to a walk before turning. No fast cuts or hard braking.

coolDown.name: Easy walk
coolDown.detail: Walk slowly for 5 minutes; let breathing settle.

coolDown.name: Standing calf stretch
coolDown.detail: 30 seconds each side, heel down; gentle hold.

coolDown.name: Standing hip-flexor stretch
coolDown.detail: 30 seconds each side in split stance; squeeze rear glute gently.

coolDown.name: Relaxed breathing
coolDown.detail: 5 comfortable breaths, roughly 4 seconds in and 6 seconds out. Do not force the breath.

conditioning.howToUse: Gaps are deliberate setup, water and transition time. All rest within exercise blocks is already included. Finish early if ready; never add work to fill the booking. Progress only when the prior session and following day were comfortable.
